classes.name: results
classes.reason: Each class_b file is written by probe.write_staged, whose os.write is followed by os.fsync before the loop can continue, so the writing rank stalls on durability; the barrier.wait() only occurs at generation boundaries, so peer ranks are meanwhile writing their own r%d files rather than waiting on this file.

classes.name: diagnostics
classes.reason: class_a goes through probe.write_buffered, which opens, os.write's and closes with no fsync, so the 4 KiB write is left to page-cache writeback overlapping later tasks, and only the issuing rank touches its own per-rank path between barriers.
